spinner.fix: Skeleton shaped like the area (SkeletonText, DataTableSkeleton); InlineLoading only at a button or field

rawDataTable.fix: Use your table component that already handles empty, noResults, loadError and totals; list its folder in skip

toggleNextToSubmit.fix: A toggle takes effect immediately; inside a form that is submitted, use a checkbox

disabledSubmit.fix: Keep submit enabled and show field errors plus a summary; block only with a visible hint and a way out

areYouSure.fix: Title = question with the object, text = consequence with count and names

errorToast.fix: Errors inline at the object, with a way out; toasts only for success

hiddenLabel.fix: Show the label; a placeholder is not a label
